category: rerank API, one-time free credit on signup

free_tier.stated: new signups receive USD 25 in free credits, USD 50 with a work email; the rerank API launch post states the first USD 50 as 1 billion tokens. Rerank-v2 costs USD 0.05 per million tokens and Rerank-v2-mini USD 0.02
free_tier.notes: the credit is USD and is shared with the vendor's agent and parse products; whether the USD 25 credit applies to the standalone rerank endpoint is stated only by the launch post for the work-email case

tooling: POST https://api.contextual.ai/v1/rerank with a bearer key; Python SDK; the reranker weights are also on Hugging Face
chaining: a rerank-only offer: it takes the candidates that any embedding API or keyword search returned as the first stage

limits.value: USD 25 of free credit (USD 50 with a work email), one-time; at USD 0.05 per million tokens USD 25 covers 500 million rerank-v2 tokens (derived), and the launch post states USD 50 as 1 billion tokens
one request may carry at most 400,000 tokens in total, and the query, instruction and any single document with its metadata at most 8,000 tokens
unverified: no requests-per-minute figure for the standalone rerank endpoint was found on the pages read

identity_cost.detail: an account on the vendor's app; a work email earns USD 50 where another address earns USD 25; the billing page asks for a card only to add credits; unverified: the sign-up form fields, because the app page could not be read

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the free credit does not renew
confidence_note: the credit amounts, prices and request caps are quoted from vendor pages; the standalone-rerank rate limit and the sign-up form are unverified.
